mutants.name: select-qa-report-returns-first
mutants.why: _select_qa_report scores files by banner and ## Verification lines and returns the highest-scoring path; bypassing scoring and always returning md_paths[0] means the banner-file wins only by accident — test 1 catches this when the first file has no banner and the second does
mutants.anchor: best_score = max(s for s, _, _ in scores)

mutants.name: restore-qa-only-guard-65
mutants.why: thread 211 removed the QA-only early return from _gate_quoted_test_nodes_exist so it fires on every step; restoring the guard means DEV steps no longer fire and test_4's assertion that the gate catches missing nodes on a DEV step breaks
mutants.anchor: """Gate 65: every tests/…::Name token quoted in any step's deposits must exist in the worktree."""

mutants.name: skip-failed-marked-check
mutants.why: _gate_qa_nodes_match_suite must verify that a FAILED-marked report line's node appears as FAILED/ERROR in the suite; replacing the check with `if False` silently passes a quoted-FAILED node absent from the suite
mutants.anchor: failed_marked = any(m in line for m in _FAILED_MARKERS)

mutants.name: invert-passed-marked-check
mutants.why: _gate_qa_nodes_match_suite must verify that a PASSED-marked node does NOT appear as FAILED in the suite; setting passed_marked=False unconditionally means PASSED-marked lines are treated as unclassified (both False → skipped) so the gate never fires when a quoted-PASSED node is contradicted by the suite
mutants.anchor: passed_marked = any(m in line for m in _PASSED_MARKERS)

mutants.name: drop-verbose-detection
mutants.why: _gate_qa_nodes_match_suite checks that quoted-PASSED nodes appear as PASSED in verbose suites; hardcoding is_verbose=False disables that check so a node absent from a verbose suite passes silently

mutants.name: heading-substring-not-full-line
mutants.why: _gate_dev_log_declared_text arm (a) must match a declared heading as a full stripped line, not a substring; replacing the set-of-stripped-lines membership test with a plain substring check lets a partial heading pass when a heading is embedded in prose
mutants.anchor: heading in {line.strip() for line in content.splitlines()}

mutants.name: verbatim-always-matches
mutants.why: _gate_dev_log_declared_text arm (b) must compare the normalized pin value against the deposit section; replacing the comparison with True means any section under the right heading passes even with the wrong value

mutants.name: drop-dev-log-declared-text-dispatch
mutants.why: _gate_dev_log_declared_text must be dispatched from check(); removing the call means declared headings and verbatim cells are never verified — test 15 checks the dispatch order and detects its absence
mutants.anchor:
# Gate 12: declared headings and verbatim cells present (every step)
    _gate_dev_log_declared_text(plan_text, step_number, project_path, parsed, failures, wt_path=wt_path)
mutants.replacement:
# Gate 12: declared headings and verbatim cells present (every step)
    pass

mutants.name: drop-verification-score
mutants.why: _select_qa_report scores +1 for a line starting with '## Verification'; dropping this score means a file with only ## Verification and no banner ties with a zero-score file and the fallback md_paths[0] wins — test 3 catches this when the second file has ## Verification and should win

mutants.name: drop-suite-full-and-largest-passed-tiebreaks
mutants.why: _select_summary_txt prefers files with 'suite'/'full' in basename, then breaks ties by largest passed count; removing both tiebreaks returns the first summary found, which fails test 17 when the suite file is second and the no-suite file has fewer passes
